Messages.Author: Orestes
Messages.Body:
"Wraith with 1 life. Masquer is immune to damage that is not
aggravated. The minion with this retainer gets +1 intercept. You may
burn this retainer to give any minion +1 intercept."

My minion with one Masquer attempts to block a +1 stealth action. If
the acting minion then increases to +2 stealth, can my minion burn the
Masquer to give itself an additional +1 intercept, thus getting +2
intercept in total? Or does burning the Masquer instantly negate its
permanent effects?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Orestes wrote:
> My minion with one Masquer attempts to block a +1 stealth action. If
> the acting minion then increases to +2 stealth, can my minion burn the
> Masquer to give itself an additional +1 intercept, thus getting +2
> intercept in total? Or does burning the Masquer instantly negate its
> permanent effects?

The latter.

The +1 stealth the employer gets for having the retainer only applies
while he has the retainer. It isn't "permanent".

If the card is burned, the effect that the card had for being in play
is lost.
